name: MedicationClinicalGeneralDrug
title: Medication Clinical General Drug
publisher: HL7 US Realm Program Management Steward
description:
This value set was originally published as part of HITSP but has been refined.
"Value set intensionally defined from RXNORM (OID: 2.16.840.1.113883.6.88)
Intersection(
  FilterOnProperty(PRESCRIBABLE,Y),
  Union(
     FilterOnProperty(TTY,SCDG),
     FilterOnProperty(TTY,SCDF),
     FilterOnProperty(TTY,SCD),
     FilterOnProperty(TTY,GPCK),
     FilterOnProperty(TTY,SCDC)
   ),"
purpose:
(Clinical Focus: All non-branded prescribable medication formulations in RxNorm except those limited to ingredient only.),(Data Element Scope: Medication orderables),(Inclusion Criteria: Prescribable medications including multiple ingredient medications.
Union(FilterOnProperty(TTY,SCDG), FilterOnProperty(TTY,SCDF), FilterOnProperty(TTY,SCD), FilterOnProperty(TTY,GPCK),
FilterOnProperty(TTY,SCDC))),(Exclusion Criteria: Concepts for proprietary representations of drugs. Non-prescribable (OTC) drugs. Ingredient formulations.)
